Pap Add-Ons

Three spices. Built in, not sprinkled.

Added dry before milling — flavour is ground into the pap. Mention your preference when ordering.

Ginger

Warming and sharp. Aids digestion and reduces nausea. Traditional pairing for nursing mothers. Pairs with all varieties.

Cloves

Aromatic and antioxidant-rich. Works best with heavier blends — Nutty Delight and Heritage Mix.

Cayenne Pepper

Heat and anti-inflammatory properties. For adults who want a savoury, warming bowl. Request intentionally.

Premium Smoked Catfish

Four standards. No compromise.

Most smoked catfish in Lagos is rushed, over-charred, or improperly stored. Here is what we do differently.

01
No Sand. No Stones. No Slime.

Every fish individually sorted and cleaned before the smoker. What you open is what you cook.

02
Zero Soot. Zero Black Residue.

Graduated coal heat eliminates charring. Soot carries HCAs — compounds linked to cancer. Our fish has none.

03
Maggot-Free. Guaranteed.

Smoked to the core, sealed immediately. No infestation. No shortcuts. The seal is your guarantee.

04
Sealed Fresh. Every Time.

Food-grade packaging sealed immediately after smoking. Retail or bulk — same standard either way.

The Process

Graduated coal smoking. Not just heat — control.

Most commercial smoking rushes at high heat, causing charring, bitterness, and soot on the fish. We do the opposite.

Our method builds heat gradually through controlled coal stages, smoking evenly from the inside out. The result is a sweet, deeply flavoured fish with no burnt exterior and no harmful residue.

It takes longer. The taste is the difference.
